description: Declarative registry of supportive tools, frameworks, and agentic skills for AgenticWorkflow

integrations.name: Ponytail
integrations.description: Anti-overengineering and YAGNI simplicity governor. Enforces the lazy senior dev ladder (fewest files, shortest working diff, deletion over addition).

directives.planning: Enforce Ponytail Ladder (Rung 1-3): Question whether every proposed component needs to exist (YAGNI). Reuse existing patterns and stdlib before introducing new abstractions or scaffolding. Reject premature architectural complexity.
directives.implementation: Enforce Ponytail Ladder (Rung 4-7): Shortest working diff wins. Minimum code that works. No unrequested abstractions, no single-impl interfaces, no boilerplate for later. Fix root causes, not symptoms.
directives.verification: Run Ponytail anti-debt check: Audit code changes for unnecessary helpers, dead config, or accidental complexity. Ensure diff is surgical.

integrations.name: TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation)
integrations.description: Official TOON v4.1 tabular serialization format. Reduces token usage by 30-60% across all structured deliverables, inter-agent data exchanges, and state logs.

directives.continuous: Emit all structured datasets, task lists, and telemetry in TOON v4.1 format instead of raw JSON or Markdown tables to conserve 30-60% tokens.
directives.handoff: Serialize final session summaries, audit ledgers, and state snapshots in high-density TOON format.

integrations.name: Fable (get-fable)
integrations.description: Autonomous engineering lifecycle harness, Fable circuit breaker, multi-pass verification, and durable continuation handoffs.

directives.planning: Structure phase deliverables into verifiable contracts with unambiguous success criteria and pre-conditions.
directives.implementation: Arm Fable Circuit Breaker: Monitor consecutive execution failures. If failure streak >= 2, halt speculative edits and trigger root-cause diagnosis.
directives.verification: Execute 3-Pass Verification: Pass 1 (Unit functionality), Pass 2 (Integration & Ripple effects), Pass 3 (AppSec, Clean Code & Taste).
directives.handoff: Generate durable continuation state into .fable/state.json and .fable/PROGRESS.md with explicit next-action pointers.

integrations.name: Caveman
integrations.description: Ultra-terse token compression mode. Cuts output tokens by 65-75% by eliminating pleasantries and prose fluff while keeping technical code, paths, and errors byte-exact.

directives.continuous: Drop articles, conversational filler, and hedging in agent logs and intermediate thought. Deliver technical facts, code, and errors verbatim without prose bloat.
directives.inter_agent: When subagents exchange task status or internal handoffs, use dense Caveman phrasing: `[component] [action] [status]. [next_action].`

integrations.name: OmniSkill
integrations.description: Dynamic agentic router and master compiler for high-reliability agent skills across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Google Antigravity, and Cursor.

directives.planning: Enforce OmniSkill Dynamic Router & SkillSpec Compilation: Decompose user intent into an optimal multi-step execution DAG (Research -> Planning -> Implementation -> Verification) and validate provider-neutral SkillSpec contracts before authoring.
directives.implementation: Enforce OmniSkill Progressive Disclosure & Host Contracts: Maintain strict separation between router frontmatter (<=1024 chars), core SKILL.md, references/, and deterministic scripts/. Respect host capabilities (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, Codex) without inventing mock tools.
directives.verification: Enforce OmniSkill 4-Layer Validation & BinEval Gates: Verify Layer 1 (Artifact validity), Layer 2 (Discovery trigger/negative precision), Layer 3 (Observable behavior assertions), and Layer 4 (Portability across target host runtimes).
